existing_features.title: Create a hero section showcasing AC services with a compelling headline, brief description of services offered, and a prominent call-to-action button for requesting service
Build a services section listing core AC services including installation, repair, maintenance, and emergency service with icons and brief descriptions for each
Implement a contact form section where users can submit their name, phone number, email, service type needed, and a message to request AC services
Create an about section highlighting company expertise, years of experience, certifications, and customer satisfaction commitment
Design a footer with company contact information including phone number, email address, business hours, and social media links

Apply a professional visual theme with a clean, modern design that conveys trust and reliability, using warm accent colors against neutral backgrounds, clear typography, and consistent spacing throughout the site
